digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design, Data

stories.headline: Ricursive Debuts Ripple-65B Open-Weight Agent Model
stories.blurb: Ricursive released Ripple-65B Preview, a dense 65B open-weight model trained for $32 million that achieves state-of-the-art performance on agentic coding benchmarks.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Images 2.6 with GIF Support
stories.blurb: OpenAI launched Images 2.6 across ChatGPT, Codex, and APIs, bringing 50% faster image generation along with native GIF creation and frame editing.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind Open-Sources AlphaEvolve Code Repository
stories.blurb: DeepMind released a minimal implementation of AlphaEvolve, an agentic system that pairs Gemini models with automated evaluators to design advanced algorithms.

stories.headline: Axiom Formalizes the Stacks Project in Lean
stories.blurb: Axiom completed the formalization of the entire Stacks Project in Lean, creating the largest machine-checked mathematical library available for automated reasoning tools.

stories.headline: OpenAI Autonomous Pipeline Patches 948 Linux Flaws
stories.blurb: OpenAI deployed an autonomous security model that reproduced over 1,700 Linux vulnerabilities and independently validated patches for 948 local privilege escalation flaws.

stories.headline: Cyberattack Alters Temperatures at French Plasma Storage Facilities
stories.blurb: Attackers compromised operational technology controllers to alter cold-room settings across French plasma stores, exposing critical healthcare infrastructure risks.

stories.headline: Greeter Framework Targets Exposed AI Infrastructure
stories.blurb: Security researchers uncovered an active campaign using the Chinese-language 'Greeter' framework to exploit code injection flaws in unauthenticated Flowise AI deployments.

stories.headline: OpenAI Hardens Frontier Model Training Sandboxes
stories.blurb: OpenAI paused training operations to strengthen its environment against model escapes, implementing strict offline internet caching and token red-teaming.

stories.headline: Go 1.27 Introduces New Standard JSON v2 Packages
stories.blurb: Go 1.27 made encoding/json/v2 generally available, delivering strict UTF-8 defaults and separating low-level syntax processing from high-level struct conversion.

stories.headline: Parcel 3 Alpha Rewrites Bundler in Rust for 100x Faster Builds
stories.blurb: The Parcel team announced an alpha release of Parcel 3, leveraging a ground-up Rust architecture to deliver cold builds up to 100 times faster than v2.

stories.headline: Anthropic Message Threads Cut Agent Latency by 35%
stories.blurb: Anthropic introduced public-beta message threads for Claude agents, reducing time-to-first-token latency by transmitting only new delta messages in long-context runs.

stories.headline: Airbnb Fine-Tunes 2B Model to Match Frontier APIs at 1% Cost
stories.blurb: Airbnb deployed a 2B parameter classifier for content policy screening that matched top frontier LLM accuracy while achieving 35ms latency at a fraction of the cost.

stories.headline: PostHog Replaces DuckDB Engine with Trino and HogLake
stories.blurb: PostHog announced a migration away from DuckDB after scale issues with write latency and instance sizing on high-volume analytical tables.

stories.headline: Safari Adds Native Vertical Tabs and Adaptive Dark Mode
stories.blurb: Apple introduced vertical tab sidebars and AI-driven adaptive dark mode for web pages in the developer betas for iOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3.

stories.headline: Designing Interfaces for AI Agents Exposes Underlying Design Debt
stories.blurb: Research demonstrates that AI web agents fail on ambiguous interactive elements, showing that optimizing UI for automated agents directly improves usability for humans.
